wizard_login.title: Wizard: Simplified Credential Extraction
wizard_login.description:
## 🚀 Step-by-Step Guide

This wizard helps you extract the required credentials from your Nest account.

### Prerequisites
⚠️ **Critical**: You must use an **Incognito/Private browser window** with **third-party cookies enabled**!

### Step 1: Open Nest and Developer Tools
1. Open an **Incognito/Private** browser window (Ctrl+Shift+N in Chrome, Ctrl+Shift+P in Firefox)
2. Go to your browser settings and **enable third-party cookies** (temporarily)
3. Navigate to [home.nest.com](https://home.nest.com)
4. Open **Developer Tools** by pressing **F12**
5. Go to the **Network** tab in Developer Tools
6. Enable **Preserve Log** checkbox in the Network tab (important!)

### Step 2: Sign In
1. Sign in to home.nest.com using your Google account
2. Wait for the page to fully load

### Step 3: Extract Issue Token URL
1. In the **Network** tab filter box, type: `issueToken`
2. Look for a request starting with `iframerpc`
3. Click on this request
4. Copy the **full Request URL** (starts with https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/iframerpc?action=issueToken...)
5. Paste it into the **Issue Token URL** field below

### Step 4: Extract Cookies
1. Clear the filter and type: `oauth2/iframe`
2. Click on the **last** request in the list
3. In the **Headers** section, find **Request Headers**
4. Locate the **cookie:** header
5. Copy the **entire cookie value** (all the text after "cookie:")
6. Paste it into the **Cookies** field below

### Step 5: Submit
1. Verify both fields are filled
2. Click **Submit**
3. ⚠️ **Do NOT log out** of home.nest.com after copying the credentials!

💡 **Tip**: The Issue Token URL should start with `https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/iframerpc` and the Cookies should contain values like HSID, SSID, APISID, SAPISID.

data_description.cookies: Complete cookie string from the oauth2/iframe request headers

account_link.title: Connect Your Nest Account
account_link.description:
Follow these steps to get your credentials:

1. Open an **Incognito/Private** browser window
2. Enable **third-party cookies** in browser settings
3. Go to [home.nest.com](https://home.nest.com) and sign in with Google
4. Open **Developer Tools** (F12) → **Network** tab → Check **Preserve Log**
5. In the filter box, type `issueToken` and copy the full **Request URL**
6. In the filter box, type `oauth2/iframe`, click the last request, and copy the entire **Cookie** header value

⚠️ Do not log out of home.nest.com after copying credentials

data_description.issue_token: Paste the full Request URL from the issueToken network call, including all query parameters.
data_description.cookies: Paste the full Cookie header value from the oauth2/iframe request (include every key=value pair, even if it wraps onto multiple lines).

error.invalid_issue_token: Invalid issue token URL. Paste the full Request URL from the issueToken call, including query parameters.
error.invalid_cookies: Invalid cookie header. Paste the entire Cookie header from the oauth2/iframe request with all key=value pairs.
